. . . building his confidence and coaxing out the magnificent beast within him. I first met Wally five years into his life, and only got to see the marvelous result -- this loyal, determined, gentle, awkward, wonderfully empathetic fellow. Truly one of the Seven Great Dogs of his time. We will miss him terribly.

We say goodbye to this handsome gentleman today. 

My wife @LilianaSegura adopted Wally 15 years ago. I don't know that any dog and human could be more perfectly suited for one another. Wally was nearly feral when Liliana got him. She spent the next several years . . .

“To say that President Trump is corrupt is to somehow understate the size, scope and magnitude of his corruption.

It is as if you were to describe a modern thermonuclear device as a ‘bomb.’ That is true enough, but it is not quite the truth. It does not capture the nature of the thing in full.”

"Send us money to help build a border wall" and then instead buying yourself 18 more rumpled polo shirts to wear simultaneously, that's donor fraud. "Send us money to help research and track extremists" and then spending that money on obtaining information about extremists groups is... not fraud.

Trump’s ICE started DRC third-country removals last week with 15 people from Latin American countries.  

And we sent an Iraqi interpreter who had helped US military to Rwanda last year. 

There is no bottom. 
gillianbrockell.com/breaking-ice...

Man. I knew the Chavez-DeRemer stuff was bad, but I didn’t realize it was pimping young female staffers out to her husband and *dad* bad. (I’m exaggerating, but only just.)

people.com/labor-secret...

Cold-blooded murder. Everyone giving or carrying out these orders must be prosecuted, full stop. Trump may enjoy executive immunity, his accomplices do not: the depraved disregard for human life exhibited by those perpetrating these murders must not go unpunished.

I can’t stop thinking about “mutilization.” It’s so mind-bendingly stupid and hilarious. If he had just said it once and then corrected it would have been completely forgotten about by now. But he can’t help himself. And the fact that JD Vance repeated it in a show of fealty is just breathtaking.
From what I've read, sending them to the developing world stems from a mix of cost effectiveness (don't have to pay them as much to take them), sadism, racism, and spite. Mostly the latter three.

The next administration must make clear that any immigrant, refugee, or asylum seeker wrongly deported, exiled, or otherwise mistreated by this administration will be readmitted with an expedited path to citizenship. Send a plane to get them.

We can't undo the damage. But we can do something.

This is monstrous. Just profoundly shameful behavior by our government.

www.nytimes.com/2026/04/21/w...

My first thought is . . . what exactly is the alleged crime here?

And then I remember -- there doesn't really need to be one.

The Rehnquist/Roberts court on Bivens: We will not let victims of abusive cops sue their abusers under this judge-created doctrine.

The same court on qualified immunity: We will hide behind this judge-created doctrine to make sure victims of police abuse cannot sue their abusers.
The @bencollins.bsky.social media empire is about to get bigger.

Anat Rubin and I co-wrote a story for @calmatters.org about the people behind Sheriff Chad Bianco's "election investigation" -- sovereign citizens, Christian nationalists, and "constitutional sheriffs."
calmatters.org/investigatio...

SORKIN: There's a whole number of very large companies, including Apple and Amazon, that have not sought reimbursements yet for the tariffs. From what I understand, part of the reason is they're worried about offending you.


TRUMP: I think it's brilliant. They got to know me very well. I'm honored.
Make this make sense.
Cuture warriors defend western civilization by banning colleges from teaching . . . er . . . Plato and Shakespeare.
Again: young people might not realize that this kind of repugnant racism was unacceptable to express publicly, *not that long ago*.

Just sobbed hardest I have since my mom died in 2020.

She missed these trials by a few months.

One of most ruthless cancers. Hard to fathom that maybe she'd still be here.

I feel such a hole inside.

In case you're wondering if we should fund mRNA research instead of another stupid war ... yes.
